Inside the course
ROBOTICS
SBHS / 2026THINK WITH YOUR HANDS.
A COURSE IN THE MAKING

We’re planning a Robotics class alongside the Makerspace club. Here’s an example of what the course could explore. The final syllabus, teacher, schedule, and enrollment details are still to come.

From a first idea
to a first movement.

01 / DESIGN

Give an idea a shape.

Sketch, model in CAD, and prototype a chassis or mechanism using the tools in the room.

02 / ELECTRONICS

Make the connections.

Explore circuits, motors, sensors, and microcontrollers. Learn how a robot reads the world.

03 / PROGRAMMING

Tell it what to do.

Write simple control programs, test movement, and work through the little surprises that make building interesting.

04 / BUILD TOGETHER

Put it all in motion.

Combine design, hardware, and code in a team project. Test it, rethink it, and make it work a little better.

You don’t have to wait for a class to start making.
